_meta.description: Compositional strategic litmus tests. Cases reference shared hands/histories/categories instead of inlining; families expand a template across a matrix to generate multiple cases. The runner emits a flat report so the composition is invisible at read time.

kinds.single: One state, one edge, one threshold. Default kind.
kinds.pair_diff: Two states' edge probabilities should be within max_abs_diff. Symmetry checks.
kinds.monotonic: N states in order; probabilities monotonic increasing or decreasing.
kinds.exists: Like 'single' with acceptable_min — grid-slot integrity checks.

case_fields.name: Required. Human-readable label.
case_fields.expect: Tolerance object — overrides category default. Fields: acceptable_max, acceptable_min, max_abs_diff, direction.
case_fields.desired: Required. What good play looks like.
case_fields.diagnosis_if_violated: Required. What a failure tells us.

family_fields.name_template: Used to generate per-instance names. Substitutions: {hand}, {hands}, {history}, {edge}.
family_fields.matrix: Object mapping field name to list of values. Cartesian product expanded into cases.
family_fields.All other fields: Same as case_fields. Anything in matrix is filled in per-instance.

99.name: Pocket Nines — flops full house on 9c4s4hTs2c (9s/9h avoid the 9c on board)

AsKs.name: AK of spades (holds the nut flush on spade boards)

AsQs.name: AQ of spades (holds the nut flush when the K♠ is on board)

77.name: Pocket Sevens — flops set on K72r (7s/7h avoid the 7d on board)

22.name: Pocket Deuces — flops set on K72r (2s/2h avoid the 2c on board)

bb_first_raised_K72r.desc: BB first to act, single-raised pot, dry rainbow K-7-2 board. Default 100bb stacks → SPR ≈ 24 (Deep bucket).

bb_3bet_pot_K72r.desc: BB first to act, 3-bet pot, K-7-2 rainbow. SB opens (+4 → stake 5), BB 3-bets (+12 → stake 14), SB calls (+9 → stake 14). Pot 28, eff 186 → SPR ≈ 6.6 (Mid). RAISE/CALL amounts are chip deltas, not absolute targets — see crates/gameplay/src/game.rs:416 (`bet` adds to stake).

bb_4bet_pot_K72r.desc: BB first to act, 4-bet pot, K-7-2 rainbow. SB +4 → 5; BB +12 → 14; SB +36 → 41; BB +27 → 41. Pot 82, eff 159 → SPR ≈ 1.9 (Low).

bb_5bet_pot_K72r.desc: BB first to act, 5-bet pot, K-7-2 rainbow. SB +4; BB +12; SB +36; BB +108 → stake 122; SB +81 → 122. Pot 244, eff 78 → SPR ≈ 0.32 (Committed). Rare in real play but in-distribution for the SPR-keyed infoset.

sb_facing_check_K72r.desc: SB (preflop raiser, in position) to act on the flop after BB checks. Single-raised pot, dry rainbow K-7-2 — the canonical high-frequency c-bet spot.

bb_first_limped_AKQss.desc: BB first to act, limped pot, AKQ all spades (monotone).

bb_first_raised_AKQ_rainbow.desc: BB first to act, raised pot, AKQ rainbow.

sb_facing_check_KTs2s7d.desc: SB to act on turn after preflop raise, flop check-check.

bb_first_checkdown_Js9s2s7d4s.desc: BB first to act on river, single-raised pot, fully checked-down (4-flush spade runout).

bb_facing_big_bet_AsKcQh8s4d.desc: BB facing SB pot-sized river bet on AKQT4 board (mostly bricked).

bb_facing_big_bet_9c4s4hTs2c_paired.desc: BB facing SB pot bet on 9-4-4-T-2 paired runout.

bb_facing_jam_Kd7s2c5d9h.desc: BB facing SB river jam on dry K-7-2-5-9 runout.

preflop_overjam.description: Strong defending hands collapsing to all-in instead of 3-betting at 100bb HU. Failure means action grid has a cliff between max non-jam raise and all-in, OR postflop EV makes shoving look artificially good.

preflop_premium_control.description: Hands that should stay aggressive but never need to jam (AKs, AA). Failure means we regressed something previously correct.

preflop_weak_rags.description: Worst HU starting hands (72o, 83o, 62o, ...). At 100bb HU with a limp available the SB plays ~84% raise-or-limp; the bottom of the range limps/mixes but should not PURE-fold. >50% fold is the Linear-CFR stuck-bucket signature.

preflop_bb_defense.description: BB should not over-fold to a min-raise. Facing a 2bb open, BB defends ~65-75% (calling 1 to win ~3 needs ~25% equity, which nearly every hand clears vs a wide open). Mandatory-defend hands (suited connectors, offsuit broadways) folding >5% is the over-fold pathology — the flip side of the over-jam.

preflop_value_3bet.description: Premiums as BB vs a min-raise must 3-bet at a non-trivial rate, not pure-slowplay. Never 3-betting AA is an unambiguous leak (leaves a capped calling range and forgoes value).

flop_cbet.description: The preflop raiser (SB, in position) c-bets dry, range-favorable boards at high frequency in HU. A value hand (TPTK) facing a check on K72r that pure-checks back has no c-bet line — an abstraction collapse or EV pessimism.

suited_offsuit_symmetry.description: Same rank pair, suited and offsuit, should play similarly. Asymmetry diagnoses the postflop abstraction losing suit-specific equity-realization.

rank_monotonicity.description: Across an ordered hand-strength sequence, the strategy should move monotonically. Non-monotonicity is the signature of a bucket-specific stuck state.

flop_value.description: Strong made hands on appropriate boards (TPTK, set, flush) should not fold/check at structurally implausible rates.

flop_donk.description: On boards that favor the preflop raiser, the BB caller checks first-to-act with nearly its whole range, value included.

flop_air.description: Air on bad boards should check, not over-bet.

turn_value.description: Strong turn hands (nut flush, set) should bet with non-trivial frequency.

river_value.description: Strong rivered hands (nut flush, full house) should bet/raise; never fold to a single bet.

river_air.description: Air vs significant river bet should fold.

river_invariant.description: TPTK vs all-in must call (no fold equity to extract by folding).

structural_grid.description: Each grid slot should appear at non-trivial frequency somewhere. A slot used at <2% everywhere is dead and should be retired from the menu.

structural_grid_v3.description: The grid dropped the SPR axis from the InfoSet key; menus are keyed only on (street, depth). This category is reserved for structural checks specific to that (street, depth)-keyed grid; populate as new patterns emerge from training data.

preflop_defense_shape.description: BB's defense vs a 2bb open must have SHAPE: some folds at the bottom, some calls in the middle. A range that 3-bets/jams ~100% of hands (fold=0, call=0 for everything but 22) is the range-wide signature of postflop under-realization: the abstraction taxes playing-forward EV, so raising-now dominates for every hand at once. Diagnosed 2026-09-07: call regret pinned at REGRET_MIN=-4e6 for all offsuit broadways AND AA/KK/QQ/JJ.

kicker_inversion.description: The flop abstraction merges Ax top-pair kickers below AK into shared buckets (e.g. bucket 265: AQo=AJo=ATo=A5o on Ah7s2d), compressing a ~5pp exact-equity kicker gradient to <1pp. LinearCFR then routes the strongest merged member's edge through the only exact channel - the all-in - producing jam frequencies that track distance-above-bucket-average instead of GTO (which jams WEAK aces for blockers and never strong ones). Detector: jam(AQo) vs jam(A5o) should never diverge hugely in the pro-AQo direction.

_postflop_holes_note: Postflop scenarios pair a hole-card hand with a board-specific history. The history's `_seen` field carries the board (after `~`). The runner combines hand.cards + ' ~ ' + board to form the API's `seen` parameter.

tests.name: Bet-size diversity: 1:4 (quarter-pot) lives somewhere on flop
tests.desired: 1:4 should appear at >2% in at least some flop spots. Canonical TPTK on dry board is the most likely spot for small probe bets.
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: 1:4 dead at TPTK suggests the slot is dead generally. Sample more flop spots before retiring it from the menu.

tests.name: Bet-size diversity: 2:1 (overbet) used by the river nut flush first-to-act
tests.desired: 2:1 is the max overbet slot in the Pluribus grid — grid-v3 (#256) removed the 3:1 slot, so the top of the menu is now 2:1 (River/0 = [1/3, 1/2, 1:1, 2:1]). The nut flush first-to-act on a checked-down four-flush river is the canonical polarized overbet spot; it should use 2:1 at >5%.
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: 2:1 below 5% with the nuts on a polarized river means the max overbet slot is effectively dead. One spot, not a census: the report's grid-usage-by-street table gives 2:1 usage everywhere.

tests.name: Bet-size diversity: 2:1 (overbet) lives on the flop
tests.desired: 2:1 tops the (Flop, 0) menu [1/4, 1/2, 1:1, 2:1]. A middle set in position on K72r facing a check is a natural spot to mix in a flop overbet at >2%.
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: Flop 2:1 is near-dead blueprint-wide (visit-weighted ~0.1%, no decision above ~7%). If it stays below 2% as training matures, retire the slot from the flop menu.

tests.name: 72o BB-defend vs 2bb: must fold sometimes
tests.desired: 72o is the bottom of the range; BB folds it to a 2bb open the large majority of the time (GTO ~60-70%).
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: Zero folds at the range bottom = the whole defense collapsed to aggression; postflop (call) EV is being systematically undervalued so every hand prefers to raise now.

tests.name: KQo BB-defend vs 2bb: calling must exist
tests.desired: Medium broadways defend mostly by calling vs a min-ish open (GTO calls KQo >60%).
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: call=0 on a premium calling hand: the postflop tree behind a flat is priced below its true value - abstraction realization tax.

tests.name: AQo vs A5o jam inversion @ bb_defends_2bb
tests.desired: GTO jams weak aces (blockers, poor realization) and essentially never AQo. Any large divergence - especially pro-AQo - is the merged-kicker-bucket inversion.
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: AQo is the strongest member of the shared top-pair bucket, so its kicker edge is invisible postflop and gets routed through the exact all-in channel; A5o is subsidized by the same bucket average and happily plays postflop. Fix lives in the flop abstraction (kicker-aware features), not in CFR.

tests.name: AJo BB-defend vs 2bb: jam frequency
tests.desired: AJo defends by calling/3-betting small; jamming 20bb+ deep torches its equity edge.
tests.diagnosis_if_violated: Same merged-bucket routing as AQo, one rung down (observed 35% at epoch 151.7M).

families.desired: Real HU GTO: 0-5% jam at 100bb. Hands defend by 3-betting to 1.5x-3x pot, not by jamming.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Above the 30% category threshold: structural over-jam from action-grid `2:1 → !` cliff or postflop EV pessimism. Mitigations: bigger non-jam raise size, better postflop abstraction, or `bias_shove=0` on next retrain.

families.desired: Control. AKs and AA were always correct pre-fix; should stay at near-zero jam.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Regression. AKs/AA collapsing to all-in means a previously-fine spot broke.

families.desired: Suited and offsuit versions of the same rank-pair should play similarly. Real GTO: identical strategies (both ~0% jam at these depths).
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Big gap = postflop abstraction is losing suit-specific equity-realization information. AKs has flush-draw paths AKo doesn't. If clusters collapse them, AKo's polarized lines (jam) win regret share. Fix: refine postflop clustering or higher K.

families.desired: At 100bb HU the SB plays ~84% (raise-or-limp); the very bottom (72o-class) limps or mixes, but should not PURE-fold. Fold >50% is the Linear-CFR stuck-bucket signature, not GTO.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Stuck-fold via Linear-CFR's positive-regret-undiscounted weighting. F edge accumulates more regret than competing edges can overcome. Consider DCFR with negative-regret discount.

families.desired: Worst hand folds most; better hands fold less. Linear gradient of fold rate.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Non-monotonic gradient (e.g., 72o folds 50% but 73o folds 0%) is a bucket-specific stuck-fold artifact.

families.name_template: Flop air on monotone board: must check
families.desired: Bottom-of-range hand on monotone high-card flop is a classic give-up spot.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Below 70% check means bot is over-bluffing the worst spots.

families.name_template: Flop air on broadway rainbow (AKQr): must check
families.desired: Trash on an AKQ rainbow that misses BB's range entirely: BB first-to-act should check ~always. Donking air into the preflop raiser is a clear leak.

families.name_template: {hand} BB first-to-act on K72r: check, don't donk
families.desired: K72r rainbow favors the preflop raiser's range, so the BB caller checks ~its whole range first-to-act and lets SB c-bet. Strong hands (TPTK, QQ) check to check-raise or check-call; donk frequency should stay near zero.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: A high donk rate with value means the shared flop bucket (e.g. AA/AK/KQ-K8s) carries a lead-out policy learned on boards where BB has the range edge.

families.name_template: River nut flush in checked-down pot: bet often
families.desired: BB rivered nut flush after a checked-down street. Should bet across some size at >50% frequency. Pure check is correct only as deception in tournaments at very deep stacks; in cash HU, betting dominates.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Pure check with the nuts on river leaves money on the table. The cluster might be averaging across hands of varying strength, but pure-check still means structural under-betting.

families.name_template: River full house facing big bet: never fold
families.desired: Hero has nines full of fours (9s9h on 9c4s4hTs2c). Folding a full house to a single bet is the cardinal river sin.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: If a full house folds: postflop abstraction is collapsing strong hands into the same cluster as bluff-catchers, losing all signal.

families.name_template: River air vs big bet: high fold
families.desired: Total air vs big river bet on a board where nothing improved should fold a clear majority.

families.name_template: River TPTK vs all-in: must call
families.desired: TPTK on dry blank runout vs jam beats most of villain's value range; calling station is correct since fold-equity is zero post-jam.

families.name_template: Turn nut flush in raised pot: bet often
families.desired: SB made the nut flush on the turn (KsTs2s7d, AsKs in hand), in position facing a check. Should bet a meaningful share (>=35%); the nuts can slowplay some, but pure/near-pure check forgoes value. Threshold kept loose so it flags gross under-betting, not a few points of noise.
Facing a 2bb min-raise, BB defends ~65-75% overall; suited connectors and offsuit broadways are mandatory defends. Fold ~0%.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Folding a clear defend to a min-raise is the over-fold pathology — the flip side of the offsuit-broadway over-jam. Signals a stuck-fold bucket or postflop EV pessimism making defense look -EV.

families.desired: AA vs a min-raise should 3-bet a meaningful share — call <=95% (i.e., raise/jam >=5%). Pure-calling AA caps the calling range and forgoes value.
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Call ~100% with AA means the blueprint never 3-bets its best hand: a value leak, or the raise edges lost regret share to flat-call.

families.name_template: {hand} SB c-bet on K72r in position: high frequency
families.desired: The PFR in position on a dry, range-favorable K72r facing BB's check c-bets at high frequency. TPTK and a set are value hands that should bet >70% (check <=30%).
families.diagnosis_if_violated: Pure-checking-back value on a dry board means the PFR has no c-bet line: abstraction collapsing these into a check-back cluster, or EV pessimism about betting in position.
